newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Solartech ends debut higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Solartech ends debut higher.

text.p: Shares of Hong Kong-based cable maker and exporter Solartech International Holdings Ltd ended their trading debut on Thursday at HK$1.35 per share compared with an issue price of HK$1.20.
Solartech shares moved in a range of HK$1.27 to HK$1.50 on volume of 86.80 million shares worth HK$124.51 million.
"The performance was satisfactory because the shares could still hold above their issue price when the overall market was on a correction," said Kinson Au, senior analyst from PW Asia Brokerage.
Analysts said they expected investors switching to other new listings to pressure prices in the short run.
Solartech offered 125 million new shares, with an attached warrant 1071.HK for every five shares. The flotation was 122.1 times subscribed.
Solartech said proceeds would be used to improve its customer network in China, expand manufacturing capacity and set up a joint venture.
